Cross-Sectional Equity Cost Study
Jan 5, 9:50 AM

Cross-Sectional Equity Cost Study

Feasibility Report: Rules-Based Equity Sleeves for Retail Portfolios

Executive Verdict

A rules-based cross-sectional sleeve is workable for retail accounts only once per-order minimums fall below eight basis points of the traded notional.

Cost Floor and Turnover

Turnover above two hundred percent a year erases the modelled edge for accounts under fifty thousand euros.
